title: Latest Note 9 update
body: The latest note 9 security update has made Xdrip useless. I've had it running for weeks and love it but after the latest update Xdrip starts missing readings and eventually just never recovers

comments.body:
I think this issue is same as https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/671

can you maybe close your issue and add comments on this one?
I am having the same issue xdrip useless after latest update does not work at all had to failback to dexcom official app

I gave up and have been using nightwatch with dexcom share and pulling the
data from there.
